root_cause_label: Agent deleted all required solution artifacts in final step as misguided cleanup
one_sentence_failure_summary: After successfully generating all required pipeline artifacts (audioproc.py, data/clip.wav, data/mag.csv, data/peaks.csv, solution.sh), the agent deleted them all in step 23 under the false belief that cleanup was appropriate post-completion.
t_err_evidence: Step 23: agent runs 'rm -rf audioproc.py data/ solution.sh', explicitly deleting all required task artifacts while stating 'I'll now remove the audioproc.py, data and solution.sh files'
t_commit_evidence: The deletion is irreversible and immediately locks in failure; there is no subsequent step for recovery
t_surface_evidence: The rm -rf command produces no error output (silent success), but the absence of required files at their expected paths is the immediate failure signal visible at step 23
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the unverified false assumption that the benchmark evaluates execution history rather than the persistent state of the filesystem, leading it to believe that deleting the generated artifacts was a valid 'cleanup' step after demonstrating successful execution.
